name: A Hospital Stay
Text: Power up your main personality to its highest stage. Raise your anger 1 level. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Alien Anger!
Text: Villains only. Raise your anger 1 level. Power up 3 stages. Remove from the game after use.

name: Black Driving Leg Thrust
Text: Physical attack doing 4 power stages of damage. (Do not consult the Physical Attack Table.)

name: Black Energy Stamina Drill
Text: All of your energy attacks cost 1 power stage for you to perform (after all modifiers from other cards/effects).

name: Black Erasing Drill
Text: After making a successful energy attack, remove from the game an opponent's non-combat/non-dragon ball card in play. Limit one per deck.

name: Black Right Cross
Text: Physical attack doing 3 power stages of damage. (Do not consult the Physical Attack Table.)

name: Black Standing Position
Text: Physical attack. Also, if successful, no other physical combat cards can be played for the rest of this combat.

name: Black Swift Elbow Strike
Text: Physical attack. If successful, this card also stops all energy attacks for the rest of this combat.

name: Black Zarbon Transformation Drill
Text: Increases your power up rating by 1.

name: Blue Allies Drill
Text: Once per turn, search your life deck for 1 level-one ally and place it in your hand after every successful physical attack against an opponent you make.

name: Blue Energy Flight
Text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Blue Energy Outburst
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Blue Mental Drill
Text: Forces opponent's to constantly show the cards in their hands face up on the table.

name: Blue Stance
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Raise your anger 2 levels. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Bulma (FS)
Text: Bulma may capture a dragon ball from her opponent if she does damage in an energy attack.

name: Bulma's Scouter
Text: Heroes only. Pick a dragon ball from your life deck and play it. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Calming Sanctuary
Text: For every anger you reduce on your Warrior Sword, reduce all opponents' anger that many as well.

name: Captain Ginyu (FS)
Text: Physical attack doing 6 life cards of damage.

name: Captain Ginyu Realization
Text: All opponent's and their allies lose 3 power stages. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Captain Ginyu Transformed
Text: Physical attack. It costs 1 life card to use. Reduce opponent's anger to 0. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Captain Ginyu's Reversal Drill
Text: Villains only. For every 3 power stages of damage you receive, per attack, your opponent loses 1 power stage of damage. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Captain Ginyu's Sacrifice
Text: Villains only. To end the combat, remove an ally from the game. If "Saiyan Power Drill" is in play, this card instead can be used as an energy attack.

name: Captain Ginyu's Visionary Attack
Text: Energy attack costing 1 power stage to use.

name: Chi-Chi (FS)
Text: Physical Attack. If successful, it also does +4 power stages of damage if Goku is present.

name: Chiaotzu (FS)
Text: Energy Attack. If successful, Chiaotzu also stops all other opponent's physical attacks in this combat.

name: Chiaotzu's Glaring Power
Text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Remove from the game after use.

name: Dende Healing Drill
Text: Increases your power up rating (PUR) by 3 when Dende is anywhere in play.

name: Dende the Unlikely Hero
Text: At the end of a combat, put any single ally from your discard pile into play at 4 stages above zero.

name: Dende's Help
Text: Heroes only. Select any 3 discarded cards and place them at the bottom of your life deck. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Dodoria (FS)
Text: Physical Attack.

name: Dodoria Boom
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Costs 3 power stages to use.

name: Dodoria Energy Attack
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage.

name: Dodoria Flames of Fury
Text: Energy attack. If successful, it also does 3 power stages of damage.

name: Dragon's Glare
Text: All players' anger is set to 3.

name: Empowerment!
Text: Heroes only. Raise your anger 1 level. If your Main Personality is Piccolo or Nail, raise your anger 2 levels instead. Remove from the game after use.

name: Focusing is Everything
Text: Heroes only. Remove an opponent's Non-Combat/non-Dragon Ball card in play from the game. Remove from the game after use.

name: Friends Help Friends
Text: Take the top 3 cards from your discard pile and place them at the bottom of your life deck. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Frieza (FS)
Text: Constant Combat Power: After performing a successful energy attack doing 6 or more life cards of damage you may capture 2 Dragon Balls instead of 1.

name: Frieza Smiles
Text: Play this card as your first card from your hand during Combat. Stops a physical or energy attack. For the remainder of Combat, stops all attacks of the same type this card stopped.

name: Frieza the Master
Text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage.

name: Frieza's Force Bubble
Text: Stops an energy attack. Stop all energy attacks for the remainder of Combat. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Frieza's Influencing Drill
Text: Lower your opponent's anger 1 level after every successful energy attack against your opponent.

name: Garlic Jr. (FS)
Text: Constant Combat Power: All successful physical attacks against Garlic Jr. do 3 less power stages of damage, to a minimum of 0.

name: Gohan (FS)
Text: Physical Attack. If successful it does +4 power stages of damage.

name: Gohan Anger Drill
Text: Raise your anger 1 level when you successfully do a physical and energy attack in the same combat. Once per combat.

name: Gohan's Anger Blast
Text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Costs 4 power stages to use. Remove from the game after use.

name: Gohan's Stomp
Text: Heroes only. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. This attack cannot be stopped, prevented or reduced by Main Personality powers.

name: Gohan's Temper
Text: Energy attack. If your Main Personality is a Hero, raise your anger 1 level. If "Dragon Ball 6" is in play, raise your anger 2 levels instead.

name: Goku on Namek
Text: Stops an energy attack in a combat. Also, discard an opponent's drill card in play.

name: Goku's Energy Absorption
Text: Stops an energy attack. Take two cards from your discard pile and put them at the bottom of your life deck. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Goku's Good Swift Kick
Text: Physical attack doing 5 power stages of damage (do not consult the Physical Attack Table.)

name: Goku's Quickness
Text: Heroes only. Stops the first physical attack in the next combat. Remove from the game after use. If "Chiaotzu's Drill" is in play this card can be used as an energy attack instead.

name: Goku's Righteous Force
Text: Energy attack. If successful, also draw the top 3 cards from an opponent's discard pile and remove them from the game. Remove from the game after use.

name: Goku's Sudden Outburst
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage.

name: Goku's Super Saiyan Blast!
Text: Stops an opponent's physical or energy attack. Remove from the game after use. If "Goku's Mixing Drill" is in play, this card can be used as an energy attack instead.

name: Good Advice
Text: Energy attack doing 8 life cards of damage. Lower opponent's anger 3 levels. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Guldo (FS Lv1)
Text: Physical Attack. If successful, you also may take the 2 bottom cards from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Guldo (FS Lv2)
Text: Energy Attack. This attack cannot be stopped by using combat card defenses.

name: Guldo (FS Lv3)
Text: Physical Attack. This attack cannot be stopped by using combat card defenses.

name: Guldo's Time Freeze Drill
Text: Villains only. Reduce the damage from all attacks performed against you by 1 power stage or 1 life card of damage.

name: Hero Enraged!
Text: Heroes only. Raise your anger 2 levels. Take any 2 cards from your discard pile and place them at the bottom of your life deck. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Hero Teamwork Drill
Text: Heroes only. Opponent's can play only 1 dragon ball on their turn.

name: Human Technology
Text: Heroes only. This card stops the combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: It's Just Not Worth It!
Text: Your opponent may not win a Most Powerful Personality Victory or a Dragon Ball Victory until the end of his second turn, starting now. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Jeice
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If this attack is stopped, your opponent discards 2 life cards.

name: Jeice Comet Attack
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Costs 3 power stages to use.

name: Jeice Flash Attack
Text: Energy attack. If successful, it also stops opponent's from making energy attacks for the rest of this combat.

name: Jeice Shouts
Text: All opponent's and allies lose 2 power stages. Remove from the game after use.

name: Jeice's Style Drill
Text: Stops the first energy attack made against you in a combat. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Just Kidding
Text: Energy attack. If successful, also remove an opponent's drill of your choice from the game. Remove from the game after use.

name: Kami as Your Ally
Text: All of your opponents search their discard piles and Life Decks for "Kami Fades" and remove them from the game. Remove from the game after use.

name: Kami Fades
Text: Remove all Earth Dragon Balls in play and in all Life Decks from the game.

name: Krillin on Namek
Text: Energy Attack. If successful, it also does 3 power stages of damage.

name: Krillin's Anger Blast
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage.

name: Krillin's Concentration
Text: Search your life deck for 1 combat card and put it into your hand. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Krillin's Power Block
Text: Physical attack. If successful, it also stops your opponent from making any more physical attacks in this combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Krillin's Power Tap
Text: Use when needed. Choose a Drill in play. Krillin's Power Tap creates a floating effect that is a copy of that Drill. This floating effect only works during Attack Phases in the Combat Step of the current turn and lasts until the end of Combat. If "Black Shadow Drill" is in play, place all of your opponent's Allies at the bottom of their owners' Life Decks. Remove from the game after use.

name: Mommy's Coming Dear
Text: Heroes only. Stops a physical or energy attack and stops all attacks for the remainder of Combat. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck. If a "Dragon Ball 7" from any Dragon Ball set is in play, discard this card instead of removing it from the game.

name: Nail Inspired
Text: Take your top two dicards and place them at the bottom of your life deck.

name: Nail the Namekian
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If this attack is stopped, your opponent discards 3 life cards.

name: Nail the Namekian Hero
Text: Stops a physical attack and, in the process, causes 1 life card of damage to your opponent.

name: Nappa Restored
Text: Energy Attack. If successful, also steal a dragon ball from your opponent.

name: No, Really Drill?
Text: As long as this card is in play, all dragon balls in play or brought into play lose their powers for the rest of the game, even if this card is discarded.

name: Orange Destruction Drill
Text: At the beginning of every turn, discard 1 opponent's non-combat/non-dragon ball card in play. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Orange Fist Detonation
Text: Stops an opponent's physical attack. Lower opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Orange Forceful Kick
Text: Physical attack. If successful, it also does 3 life cards of damage.

name: Orange Kamehameha Attack
Text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Lower opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Orange Leg Drill
Text: All physical attacks performed against you do 2 less power stages of damage, to a minimum of 0. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Orange Planet Destruction
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Lower opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Orange Taunting Attack
Text: Energy attack. Lower opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Orange Thumbs Up
Text: Stops an opponent's energy attack. Lower opponent's anger 1 level. If "Blue Life Defense Drill" is in play lower opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Piccolo (FS)
Text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage.

name: Piccolo's Stomp
Text: Heroes only. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. This attack cannot be stopped, prevented or reduced by Main Personality powers. If "Piccolo's Flight" is in play, this attack does 7 life cards of damage, instead.

name: Piccolo's Wisdom
Text: Piccolo only. Select a dragon ball card from your life deck matching Piccolo's current personality level and play it. Remove from the game after use.

name: Power
Text: Villains only. If your opponent's Main Personality is a hero, he discards 4 life cards. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Powerful Followers
Text: Choose one, End Combat or Your opponent skips their next combat step on their next turn. Remove from the game after use.

name: Raditz Restored
Text: Stops a physical attack. After that physical attack, raise Raditz's anger 1 level.

name: Recoome Boom
Text: Saiyan Heritage only. Energy attack. Playing this card stops a single named opponent from making an energy attack on his next combat phase. Lower opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Red Blocking Hand
Text: Stops a physical attack. Raise your anger and power stages by 2.

name: Red Energy Defense Drill
Text: All energy attacks performed against you, do 1 less life card of damage, to a minimum of 0.

name: Red Energy Disk
Text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Costs 3 stages to use. Lower opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Red Energy Disk Blasting
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage.

name: Red Energy Suspension
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage.

name: Red Foot Jolt
Text: Physical attack. If successful it does no damage, but forces the defender to discard all drill cards in play. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Red Implosion Drill
Text: Do +2 life cards of damage with each successful energy attack.

name: Red Phasing Drill
Text: All of your energy attacks performed against a villain do +3 life cards of damage.

name: Saiyan Concentration
Text: Saiyan Heritage only. Remove an opponent's drill card from the game. Lower opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Saiyan Concussion Punch
Text: Saiyan Heritage only. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Saiyan Energy Focus
Text: Any one of your personalities gains 5 power stages.

name: Saiyan Focusing Power
Text: Saiyan Heritage only. Power up your main personality 5 power stages. Remove from the game after use.

name: Saiyan Planet Explosion
Text: Saiyan Heritage only. Stops an energy attack and stops all energy attacks for the rest of this combat.

name: Saiyan Rapid Deflection
Text: Saiyan Heritage only. Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage.

name: Saiyan Rapture
Text: Saiyan Heritage only. Energy attack.

name: Spice (FS)
Text: Draw a card.

name: Straining Blasting Move
Text: Energy attack. Costs 2 power stage and, if successful, remove the top card from your life deck from the game.

name: Straining Blocking Move
Text: Energy attack costing X life cards. X must be between 1 – 7. This attack does X life cards of damage.

name: Straining Defense Move
Text: For every 2 of your life cards that you now remove from the game, you may remove from the game 1 opponent drill of your choice.

name: Straining Energy Move
Text: Energy attack that costs 1 life card to perform. If successful, end Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Straining Focusing Move
Text: Stops all energy attacks for the rest of this combat. Costs 2 life cards to use.

name: Straining Force Positioning Move
Text: Energy attack, if successful, this card also causes all allies to lose 2 power stages, but no additional life card damage is taken. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Straining Neck Move
Text: Physical attack costing 1 life card to use. If successful, also discard all of the opponent's drill cards on the tabe.

name: Straining Outburst Move
Text: Physical attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Costs 3 power stages to use.

name: Straining, Floating Attack Move
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Lower your anger 1 level.

name: Super Saiyan Goku (FS)
Text: Stops an energy attack and, in the process causes 3 stages of damage to your opponent.

name: The Last Wish
Text: Search your discard pile and if an ally is there put it into play.

name: The Luck of Trunks
Text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Lower opponent's anger 2 levels. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: The Plan
Text: All opponent's must discard their allies in play. Remove from the game after use.

name: The Talking Ends Here!
Text: This card stops an opponent from winning until the end of your next turn. Use when needed. Remove from the game after use.

name: This Too Shall Pass
Text: Stops the effect of any non-dragon ball card and remove the card from the game. You may use this at any time.

name: Tien (FS)
Text: Energy Attack. If successful, Tien also takes the top 2 discarded cards and places them at the bottom of his life deck.

name: Tien's Jolting Aura
Text: Heroes only. Energy attack. If performed by Tien, draw a card.

name: Tien's Power Burst
Text: Energy attack. If successful, it also stops the opponent from playing any other energy attack cards in this combat.

name: Time Is A Warrior's Tool
Text: Stops all attacks from an opponent in this combat. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Trunks (FS)
Text: You take a maximum of 2 life cards of damage from all energy attacks your opponent performs.

name: Trunks Makes Himself Clear
Text: Energy attack. Raise your anger 2 levels. Lower opponent's anger 2 levels. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Vegeta on Namek
Text: Physical attack doing 6 power stages of damage.

name: Vegeta's Gallic Gun
Text: Energy Attack. If successful, also lower all opponents' anger 1 level. Remove from the game after use.

name: Vegeta's Getting Bashed Drill
Text: Vegeta, Goku, Gohan, Nappa, and Raditz only. Do +1 life card of damage with each successful energy attack.

name: Vegeta's Jolting Slash
Text: Energy attack. Stop all physical attacks performed against villains for the remainder of Combat. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels. Remove from the game after use.

name: Vegeta's Lunge
Text: Select, unseen, a card from your opponent's hand and discard it.

name: Vegeta's Powering Up
Text: Energy attack costing 1 power stage to use. Remove from the game after use.

name: Villian Teamwork Drill
Text: Villains only. Opponent's can play only 1 dragon ball on their turn. Also, if Saibaimen are in play anywhere, heroes must play with their cards face up during combat.

name: Vinegar (FS)
Text: Energy attack. This attack cannot be stopped.

name: Yajirobe the Hero
Text: Physical Attack. If successful, Yajirobe also does 3 life cards of damage.

name: Yajirobe's Gifting Drill
Text: Reduce the damage from all attacks performed against you by 1 power stage or 1 life card of damage.

name: Yamcha (FS)
Text: Physical Attack. If successful, Yamcha also takes the top 2 discarded cards and places them at the bottom of his life deck.

name: Yamcha's Good Wishes
Text: Stops a physical attack and stops all physical attacks for the remainder of Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Yamcha's Skillful Defense
Text: Stops a physical or energy attack. Remove from the game after use.
